newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers no surplus power for Tues through Thurs.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers no surplus power for Tues through Thurs.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered no surplus power for Tuesday through Thursday pre-schedulings, the federal agency said Monday.
Trade sources at BPA in Portland, Oregon, attributed the absence of surplus power to recent flood control efforts on the regional hydroelectric dam system.
BPA listed its offers through Thursday due to the New Year holiday.
Over the weekend through Monday, BPA had offered both firm and non-firm power during peak and off-peak hours, limiting firm on-peak power to 500 megawatts (MW) for Saturday and Monday.
Prices for Monday ranged from $21.75 per megawatt hour (MWh) for non-firm power during heavy load hours at the California-Oregon border (COB) to $14.25 for firm power during light-load hours.
